month_theme: Final prep — 18 days to Phase 1 launch

Set up Phase 1 workspace — laptop is upgraded (32GB RAM, done in Taipei). First day back in Panama: install VSCode + GCC for C++, reinstall Fusion360, verify everything runs. Your tools should be ready before Aug 1.

Review and confirm career plan — credential stack was updated July 4 (ECE minor, ML/AI minor, Robotics cert, I&E cert for Duke). Read through the full plan and confirm it aligns with Duke Fall 2027 and Phase 1-3 milestones.

First Krav Maga session back in Panama — get back on the weekday evening schedule after Taiwan travel.
